description_en: Queries the list of VSwitches based on conditions
name: DescribeVSwitches

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region to which the VSwitch to query belongs
parameters.help_zh: 待查询的交换机所属的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC to which the VSwitch to query belongs
parameters.help_zh: 待查询的交换机所属VPC的ID
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The page number of the VSwitch list. Default value: 1. Valid values: 1 to 100
parameters.help_zh: 交换机列表的页码。默认值：1，取值范围：1~100
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for a paginated query. Default value: 50. Valid values: 1 to 50
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时设置的每页行数。默认值：50，取值范围：1~50
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the zone to which the VSwitch to query belongs
parameters.help_zh: 待查询的交换机所属的可用区ID
parameters.name: zone_id
